## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: 25 runs, 2-1 to 2-26; 2-22 absent. D 6, D_r 0 and gamma 24.4 in every run (table). Run 2-20 (d 4, V_H 14.20) is the run of the Fig. 4-5 record, whose header prints 15 fps while text 4-4 (PDF 189) says 14 fps; Fig. 4-5 has no experiment row. 2-9 d cell illegible. Missing: fill depth of each bed and runs per bed, footpad dimensions beyond D, whether the pad pivot was free or locked, how the pad was brought to depth d, A_ft and A_pt values, per-run density (g_p varies, D_r and gamma are one value per table), gravity (Earth inferred).
- Codex: 25 runs. Skips 2-22. Table D_r and gamma constant. Run 2-9 d illegible. Run 2-20 is 14.20 fps here, 15 fps in F4-5 and 14 feet per second in text 4-4. F2-57 lists 2-41 outside this table. Exact pad profile and run-specific fill depth unreported.
